investment_plan.thesis: Deeply oversold entry in a technically intact uptrend, with the Crinetics acquisition signaling offensive pipeline expansion — since confirmed by raised guidance and a completed buyback, so the price target is raised.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $448.95 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Crinetics-opkøbet viser overbetaling/integrationsproblemer, eller ved pipeline-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Flex Ltd.
decisions.reasoning: EPC Power-opkøbet ($4.4 mia.) er et veltimet bud på AI-datacenter-strømbehov, og markedet belønner handlen; peer Jabil bekræfter samme AI-infrastruktur-tema. Integrationsrisiko på en så stor handel er reel, men ikke et brud på tesen endnu — holder.
bull: The $4.4B EPC Power acquisition meaningfully expands Flex's exposure to AI data-center power conversion, a high-growth end market, and shares are rallying on the news.
Peer Jabil is also outperforming on AI-infrastructure diversification, validating the read-through for contract manufacturers moving into power/energy.
bear: At $4.4B, the deal is large relative to Flex's size, creating real integration and leverage risk.

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise earnings ignored by the market in a broad tech selloff gave a deeply oversold entry; the EPC Power acquisition adds a fresh AI-infrastructure catalyst but also integration risk.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $85.68 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller fortsat makrodrevet selloff uden bundtegn, eller ved tegn på fejlslagen EPC Power-integration.

decisions.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Det nye custom-chip-partnerskab med Qualcomm uddyber AWS' AI-infrastruktur-moat, og teknikken er sund (over begge SMA'er, neutral RSI). Bredere markedsskepsis om AI-capex-ROI er en sektor-bred modvind, men ikke selskabsspecifik — thesis om AI-monetisering på tværs af cloud/retail forbliver intakt, holder.
bull: New custom data-center chip partnership with Qualcomm deepens AWS's AI infrastructure moat, and the Amazon Leo/Delta in-flight wifi win shows optionality beyond core retail and AWS.
Technicals are healthy — above both SMA50 and SMA200 with a neutral RSI (47.5), not overbought or oversold.
bear: Broader market skepticism about AI-capex ROI (e.g., questions about AI-office productivity payback) is a sector-wide overhang that could weigh on the AWS capex narrative.

investment_plan.thesis: Earnings-driven breakout confirmed AI monetization across cloud and retail.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $253.07 (2x ATR, lige under breakout-niveau). Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.

decisions.name: Walt Disney Company (The)
decisions.reasoning: Disney har den sundeste teknik i porteføljen (over begge SMA'er, neutral RSI 52.8), og en $60 mia. parks/cruise-investeringsplan understøtter langsigtet vækst i Experiences-segmentet. Lukningen af online-butikker i flere markeder er en reel bekymring for consumer products, men underminerer ikke NFL/bundle-tesen — holder.
bull: A $60B parks and cruise investment pipeline supports durable long-term Experiences segment growth.
The healthiest technical setup in this group — above both the 50-day and 200-day SMAs with a neutral RSI (52.8).
bear: Disney is shutting down its online store in several major markets as part of a broader retail pullback, signaling ongoing consumer-products softness.
Rising park ticket prices (>$200/ticket) risk consumer pushback on attendance if affordability concerns grow.

investment_plan.thesis: The NFL content deal and bundle strategy are visibly working — falling churn, rising subscriber growth and analyst target hikes after a fifth straight earnings beat.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $99.98 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis streaming-bundle-økonomien eller NFL-indholdsomkostninger eroderer marginforbedringen, eller ved skarpt reversal uden opfølgning.

decisions.name: Loews Corporation
decisions.reasoning: Positionen er ekstremt lille (0.3% vægt) og handler lige omkring 200-dages support med stop kun ~0.03% under nuværende kurs ($108.25 vs. $108.22) — stoppet er endnu ikke brudt. Verdict er nedgraderet fra BULL til NEUTRAL, og svækket forsikringsunderwriting er en reel kvalitetsbekymring der matcher exit-betingelsen direkte — overvåges meget tæt og sælges ved næste bekræftede svækkelse eller stop-brud, men holdes lige nu da stoppet formelt ikke er ramt.
bull: Q2 net income and book value per share both grew meaningfully year over year, and the conglomerate structure (insurance, pipelines, hotels) cushions single-segment weakness.
Oversold (RSI 31.5) right at flat 200-day SMA support.
bear: Underwriting profitability is explicitly slipping per the latest report, a core insurance-quality metric.
Sitting right at 200-day SMA support with no clear catalyst yet to reverse the recent slide.

investment_plan.thesis: Solid Q2 beat in hotels/pipelines and an extremely oversold RSI relative to the mild 5-day decline point to a technical bounce in a fundamentally healthy conglomerate.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $108.22 (2x ATR) — kun ~1% fra nuværende kurs. Sælg hvis CNA-forsikringsunderwriting svækkes markant yderligere, eller ved brud på RSI-bounce-tesen uden opfølgning.

decisions.name: Keysight Technologies
decisions.reasoning: Et nyt AI-safety-forskningssamarbejde udvider Keysights relevans inden for validering af autonome/AI-systemer, og teknikken er sund med positiv 5-dages momentum. Test-udstyrsefterspørgsel er cyklisk, men det beat-and-raise-drevne fundamentale billede, som blot er overskygget af en bred tech-selloff, er intakt — holder.
bull: A new AI-safety research collaboration (with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy) extends Keysight's relevance in AI/autonomous-systems validation testing.
Healthy technicals — above both SMA50 and SMA200 with solid recent momentum (+3.32% over 5 days).
bear: Simply Wall St's framing ('is it still below fair value?') suggests the valuation debate remains unresolved.
Semiconductor and telecom test-equipment demand is inherently cyclical and tied to customer capex cycles.

investment_plan.thesis: Genuine fundamental improvement (beat-and-raise on AI infrastructure) is masked by a broad tech-sector selloff, giving a sentiment-driven, not company-specific, entry point.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $289.67 (2x ATR). Sælg ved bekræftet forværring af leveringsbegrænsninger eller selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Aflac
decisions.reasoning: Aflac er fortsat en Dividend Aristocrat med 25+ års forhøjelser og handler over 200-dages SMA trods et oversolgt kortsigtet niveau. Analytiker-skepsis og underperformance mod peers er en svaghed at holde øje med, men ikke et fundamentalt brud på renteforpresset-tesen — holder.
bull: Dividend Aristocrat status with a 25+ year raise streak underpins a durable capital-return profile.
Still above its 200-day SMA despite an oversold short-term reading (RSI 33).
bear: Barchart notes Aflac has trailed insurance peers over the past year and analysts are explicitly skeptical of the near-term outlook.
Below the 50-day SMA, showing near-term momentum has turned negative.

investment_plan.thesis: Sector-wide, rate-triggered selloff gave a deeply oversold entry into a quality insurer with 43 consecutive years of dividend raises, still above its 200-day average.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $111.84 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis renteforpresset på forsikringssektoren viser sig strukturelt vedvarende, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Freeport-McMoRan
decisions.reasoning: Kobber satte i dag ny rekordhøj pris, hvilket er en direkte, kvantificeret indtjeningsmedvind for Freeport (ca. $390 mio. i årlig EBITDA pr. 10-cent bevægelse). RSI 68.4 efter et kraftigt enkeltdagsspring gør aktien teknisk strakt på kort sigt, og stop ved $72.17 er tæt på — overvåges tæt, men tesen om strukturel AI-datacenter-drevet kobberefterspørgsel er intakt, holder.
bull: Copper just hit a record high ($14,694/ton), and each 10-cent move is worth roughly $390M of annual EBITDA by management's own sensitivity model — a direct, quantified earnings tailwind.
Strong uptrend — price is nearly 26% above the 200-day SMA.
bear: RSI at 68.4 after a sharp one-day 5.35% spike leaves the stock technically stretched and vulnerable to near-term profit-taking.
Part of the copper strength is tied to tariff-driven trade tension (Canada's retaliatory tariffs), a geopolitical variable that can reverse quickly.

investment_plan.thesis: Confirmed technical uptrend in copper on structural AI-datacenter demand, while also diversifying the portfolio out of heavy Industrials/Financials exposure into Materials.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $72.17 (2x ATR) — kun ~0.8% fra nuværende kurs, overvåg tæt. Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller hvis AI-capex/kobbertemaet svækkes fundamentalt.

decisions.name: CrowdStrike
decisions.reasoning: CrowdStrikes omsætning er næsten fordoblet over 8 kvartaler relativt til OKTA — bekræftede strukturelle markedsandelsgevinster — og den langsigtede optrend er intakt (47% over 200-dages SMA). Et enkelt-session ETF-udsalg i software-sektoren og et mildt tilbagefald under 50-dages SMA er tegn på afkølende momentum, men ikke et selskabsspecifikt brud — holder.
bull: Revenue has nearly doubled over 8 quarters versus OKTA, showing structural competitive share gains, and the average broker recommendation is a Buy.
Massive long-term uptrend intact — price is nearly 47% above the 200-day SMA.
bear: The software sector saw a $700M single-session ETF outflow (IGV) just before earnings volatility, showing skittish near-term positioning.
Price has pulled back just over 4% below the 50-day SMA, suggesting momentum is cooling after a huge run.

investment_plan.thesis: Confirmed beat-and-raise quarter on AI-security demand with peer confirmation (PANW), entered at reduced size due to the extreme single-day gap and elevated IT sector exposure (18.9% at the time).
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $205.13 (2x ATR). Sælg ved bekræftet mean-reversion under 50-dages SMA eller selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: MGM Resorts
decisions.reasoning: Scout-køb for at diversificere ud af den tunge IT/Industrials/Financials-eksponering (hhv. 21.8%/14.6%/16.4%) og ind i Consumer Discretionary, som aktuelt kun udgør 1.0% af porteføljen. MGM holder sin langsigtede optrend (2.78% over 200-dages SMA) trods et oversolgt kortsigtet niveau (RSI 26.5), med BetMGM positioneret mod prediction-market-konkurrenter op til NFL-sæsonen og spekulation om opkøbspræmie som friske katalysatorer. Lav screener-score (24) og eksponering mod forbrugerfølsom spil/rejse-efterspørgsel begrunder en moderat, ikke-koncentreret positionsstørrelse.
bull: BetMGM positioneres mod prediction-market-konkurrenter (Polymarket m.fl.) op til NFL-sæsonstart, og institutionelle investorer har flagget opkøbspræmie-spekulation i aktien.
Fortsat over 200-dages SMA (+2.78%) trods kortsigtet pullback under 50-dages SMA — langsigtet optrend intakt; RSI 26.5 er oversolgt.
bear: Eksponering mod forbrugerfølsom spil/rejse-efterspørgsel er sårbar over for makroskrøbelighed i Vegas-besøgstal og sports-betting-handle.
Lav screener-score (24) afspejler en svagere samlet momentum/kvalitetsprofil end topnavnene i universet.

investment_plan.thesis: Scout-position: MGM holder sin langsigtede optrend ind i NFL-sæson, med BetMGM-positionering og M&A-spekulation som opsidekatalysatorer, trods et oversolgt kortsigtet tilbagefald.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $39.03 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis forbrugerudgifter til spil/rejser viser klar makro-drevet opbremsning, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
decisions.reasoning: Andet scout-køb i samme diversificeringsøjemed (Consumer Discretionary kun 1.0% af porteføljen før i dag). RL er teknisk oversolgt (RSI 26.1) mens analytikere aktivt hæver indtjeningsestimater — et klassisk contrarian-turnaround-setup — understøttet af fortsat AI/digital-investering i brand-discovery og kundeoplevelse. Harvey Nichols-lukningen er en reel, men begrænset, engangsmodvind for wholesale-kanalen i UK. Positioneret moderat (ca. 10% vægt) givet konfidens 6 og eksponering mod europæisk luksusforbrug.
bull: Zacks flager et oversolgt teknisk setup (RSI 26) kombineret med at analytikere hæver indtjeningsestimater — et klassisk actionable turnaround-signal.
Fortsat AI/digital-investering forbedrer kundeoplevelse og brand discovery, og den premium brand-positionering er mere modstandsdygtig end masse-beklædning.
bear: Harvey Nichols-lukningen skaber et tab i wholesale-kanalen i UK for Ralph Lauren og andre premium-mærker.
Fortsat markant ned over den seneste måned trods dagens beskedne bounce.

investment_plan.thesis: Ralph Lauren fremstår oversolgt mens Wall Street hæver estimater ind i tilbagefaldet — et klassisk contrarian turnaround-setup, trods et mindre wholesale-kanaltab fra Harvey Nichols' lukning.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $327.37 (2x ATR). Sælg ved fortsat opbremsning i europæisk luksusforbrug eller selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.
